steps.instruction: Cream the butter, brown sugar, and granulated sugar until creamy.
Mix in the egg, egg yolk, vanilla extract, and Biscoff cookie butter.
Mix the flour, cornstarch, baking soda, and salt separately.
Gradually incorporate the dry ingredients into the wet mixture.
Fold in the white chocolate and broken Biscoff cookies. Exact white chocolate and selected cookie count remain unconfirmed.
Divide into cookies. Exact full-batch yield and portion weight are unconfirmed.
Bake at 350°F for approximately 10 to 12 minutes, as discussed in the working recipe; original video's full instructions remain unverified.
A Biscoff drizzle was discussed, using an indicated 2 tbsp of spread; exact application and whether it is additional to or reserved from the 1/4 cup remain unconfirmed.
